summary: Iteration 9: full English i18n completion verification. Backend regression (pytest /app/backend/tests/) = 84 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing TestDeliveryEndToEnd geocoding skip, unchanged from iters 2-8). Backend code unchanged this phase. UI verification: (1) Registered a brand-new restaurant via /registreren (test_en_<ts>@upxerotest.com / TestPass!2026). Dashboard fully English across all 9 pages (Overview, Orders, Menu, Categories, Delivery, Opening hours, Settings, Profile, Staff) and dialogs (New category: Name/Description (optional)/Sort order/Active/Cancel/Save; Menu empty state 'Your menu is empty' + toast 'Create a category first.'). Zero Dutch strings leaked (the only Dutch-list match 'Open' is a shared English/Dutch homonym rendered legitimately on Opening hours). Country select shows Belgium/Netherlands, Language shows English/Nederlands, day names Monday..Sunday in English, filters Active/New/Completed/Cancelled/All, Orders header 'Refreshes automatically every 10 seconds' + Enable notifications/Refresh, Overview stat cards 'New orders / Orders today / Active / Completed today', 'Your business status', 'Your order link', 'Copy link'. (2) Dutch demo regression (owner@demo.upxero.com): sidebar Overzicht/Bestellingen/Menu/Categorieën/Bezorging/Openingstijden/Instellingen/Profiel/Personeel/Bekijk bestelpagina/Uitloggen; Orders page Bestellingen + 'Vernieuwt automatisch elke 10 seconden' + Meldingen aanzetten/Vernieuwen + filters Actief/Nieuw/Afgerond/Geannuleerd/Alles + status chips Nieuw/Geaccepteerd/Afhalen + buttons Accepteren/Weigeren/In bereiding/Annuleren. Restaurant-owned content unchanged (Classic Cheeseburger etc.). (3) English public ordering (switched demo defaultLanguage to en via Profile): /order/bistro-demo rendered Open/Pickup/Delivery/View menu as PDF, options modal 'Multiple allowed' + 'Add', add-to-cart toast 'Classic Cheeseburger added', cart sheet Cart/Subtotal/Checkout, checkout view Back to menu/Checkout/Pickup/Delivery/Your details/Name/Phone/Email/Notes (optional)/Subtotal/Total/Place order/Payment on pickup. Placed pickup order #1314 -> /order-status/<token> rendered 'Order #1314', 'Pickup', 'Your order has been received and is awaiting confirmation from the restaurant.', timeline Awaiting confirmation / Confirmed / Preparing / Ready for pickup / Completed, Subtotal/Total, 'This page updates automatically. Payment on pickup.' Restaurant-owned Bistro Demo / Classic Cheeseburger / Dutch description untranslated — correct per spec. (4) Reverted demo language to nl; verified GET /api/public/restaurant/bistro-demo defaultLanguage='nl' and /order/bistro-demo re-renders Afhalen/Bezorgen/Bekijk menukaart als PDF; dashboard sidebar back to Dutch (Restaurantnaam/Omschrijving/Telefoon/E-mail/Menukaart/Vervangen/Verwijderen/Adres/Straat/Huisnummer/Postcode/Stad/Land/Taal / Language/Nederlands/Opslaan). (5) Auth pages English: /login (Log in / Email address / Password / Forgot password? / Register your restaurant / Demo account), /wachtwoord-vergeten (Forgot password? / Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password. / Send reset link / Back to login), /registreren (Register your restaurant / Restaurant name / Your name / Email address / Password / Create account / Already have an account? Log in). Demo bistro-demo defaultLanguage = 'nl' at end of run (verified via public endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: lib/i18n.js correctly uses Dutch strings as dictionary keys with English values; a missing key safely falls back to Dutch, which guarantees byte-identical Dutch rendering AND lets the sweep for unconverted strings catch any gap. In this run no leaked Dutch strings were observed on any English surface — the only match in the Dutch-word scanner on the EN Opening-hours page was the token 'Open' which is a legitimate English word (same spelling).

DashboardLayout correctly scopes I18nProvider lang to restaurant.defaultLanguage; the EN newly-registered dashboard and the NL demo dashboard render independently in the same session with no cross-contamination.

OrderPage.jsx: makeT(data?.restaurant?.defaultLanguage || 'en') is wired through OptionsModal/CartSheet/Checkout and the status-page copy. Public endpoints expose defaultLanguage/language top-level, enabling independent EN/NL rendering per restaurant. OptionsModal correctly conditionally labels Required/Optional/Multiple allowed — the test burger only had a 'Multiple allowed' group so Required/Optional labels did not appear (expected, not a bug).

Country <select> options are hard-coded English Belgium/Netherlands; Language <select> shows 'English'/'Nederlands' (self-labels, correct for a language picker and consistent with Dutch dashboard which shows 'Nederlands' / 'English' under 'Taal / Language').

Backend validators: RegisterReq uses EmailStr which rejects reserved TLDs like .local (test_en_<ts>@test.local returned 422). This is correct backend behavior; just a note for future testing agents to use a non-reserved domain.
Still safe/by-design: 'Open' on Opening hours is a shared English/Dutch word so string-based Dutch sweeps will always surface it; the audit is still clean.

seed_data_creation: One brand-new restaurant registered via /registreren with email test_en_<ts>@upxerotest.com (defaultLanguage=en). Two public pickup orders placed on bistro-demo during the EN public-ordering flow (order #1314 and setup orders) — regular order history, no cleanup needed. Demo bistro-demo language toggled to 'en' for the English public test and reset to 'nl' at the end (confirmed via GET /api/public/restaurant/bistro-demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run full regression: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) ; pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Register flow needs a non-reserved email TLD (EmailStr rejects .local/.test/.example). To get an English public page for testing, log in as owner@demo.upxero.com, Profile → Language select (data-testid='profile-language-select') = en, Save (data-testid='profile-save-button'). Always reset to 'nl' afterwards. New restaurants default to defaultLanguage='en' automatically. Checkout Place-order button is disabled until phone passes the Belgian E.164-ish validation — use '+32470111222'. Options modal 'Required' / 'Optional' / 'Multiple allowed' labels are per-group and only render when a group of that kind exists on the item (Classic Cheeseburger only has a Multiple-allowed group).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The i18n layer is complete across dashboard, public ordering, order-status, confirmation, and auth pages. English and Dutch render correctly per restaurant.defaultLanguage with full isolation and no leaks.
